title: The Penitent's Steps
text: Three thousand stone steps climb the mountainside, worn into bowls by knees and stained brown in the hollows. Climb on your knees, the old priests said, and be forgiven. Each time someone reaches the top, a bell rings faintly.

options.label: Climb on your knees, all of you together, to be forgiven as the priests promised.

outcomes.text: It takes a day and a night, and the stone takes skin. You are forgiven something; you feel it go.

options.label: Walk up like anyone else; you have no time to crawl.

outcomes.text: It is faster, but the priests at the top look at you sideways and say so in their letters home.

options.label: The strongest carries the weakest up, every one of the three thousand steps.

outcomes.text: Their legs are ruined by the climb. At the top, people talk about it for years.
